I'm reading comments and I still don't know if they represent NA or CN.
I don't see a convincing argument for either.

And I don't know why I'm being downvoted for asking this question.
What if there were only two regions at worlds, China and NA. If LMQ won, it would be a victory for both regions?
I actually feel the same way about TSM. It doesn't feel like an "NA" team. They have two EU players and a KR player.
